sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Friend From the West is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So, ready for some serious work? Long story short, the tourists have started getting on my nerves. They're sticking their noses everywhere, taking ou my lads, messing with my supply routes. I don't like it one bit. I'll pay you nicely if you give them a proper shake-up."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 1,000 Euros
  - 1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Not bad. Here, take these little gifts. By the way, you took out one of their big shots. They’re properly shitting themselves now."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to eliminate 5 PMCs on any map.
